purpose: Category-specific image direction derived from marketplace image jobs, real category PDPs, and the user-supplied Pinterest prompt-card pattern.

observedGrammar: finished commercial product image paired with a reusable prompt card
clear subject hierarchy with one product as the hero
specific setting and lighting instead of a generic empty background
small number of supporting props chosen to explain use or mood
prompt includes negative constraints to protect the product and composition
referencePattern.boundary: Use the visual grammar as inspiration. Do not copy the exact prompt, infer marketplace performance, or allow generated styling to change product identity.

sharedImageContract.mode: one category-specific image per first test
reject: plain empty background as the only creative
sharedImageContract.assetRole: secondary lifestyle or campaign image; create a separate marketplace-main-image brief when that job is requested

directions.setting: warm ivory stone beside clear water, one soft botanical leaf, gentle window light
directions.buyerDetail: bottle, black dropper, amber glass, and label
directions.lesson: show the routine mood without hiding the bottle or inventing skincare claims

directions.setting: bright calm kitchen counter with fresh coffee, a few beans, soft morning window light
directions.buyerDetail: whole machine, carafe, water level, and controls
directions.lesson: show the daily use moment while keeping the machine shape and controls readable

directions.setting: clean urban morning running path with textured ground and low directional light
directions.buyerDetail: side shape, heel, true color, and sole edge
directions.lesson: show the shoe in motion-ready context without hiding the sole or changing its shape

directions.setting: warm entryway console with folded neutral scarf and soft daylight
directions.buyerDetail: bag silhouette, strap, opening, and believable scale
directions.lesson: make scale and carrying use easier to judge than vague luxury language

directions.setting: dark walnut or charcoal stone surface with one soft highlight
directions.buyerDetail: readable dial, hands, case edge, crown, and finish without glare
directions.lesson: premium mood is useful only when the time face and hardware stay clear

directions.setting: bright terrace beside pale stone with soft sky reflection and restrained shadow
directions.buyerDetail: full frame, lens color, bridge, and hinge edge
directions.lesson: use reflection as atmosphere but keep the frame and lens color honest

directions.setting: tidy work desk with notebook and drink nearby, warm natural light
directions.buyerDetail: body size, lid, handle, and drinking opening
directions.lesson: a familiar desk gives scale without crowding the lid or opening

directions.setting: minimal travel desk or charging station with soft cool highlight
directions.buyerDetail: charging case, both earbuds, fit shape, and controls
directions.lesson: the viewer should see what is included and how the case is used

directions.setting: clean desk by a window with phone installed and one scale object
directions.buyerDetail: phone fit, camera cutout, buttons, ports, and edge thickness
directions.lesson: show the case on the phone so fit and protection details can be checked

directions.setting: calm late-afternoon desk with a believable pool of light
directions.buyerDetail: base, stem, hinge, shade, and control
directions.lesson: light on the work surface proves the lamp's job better than an isolated product

directions.setting: bright home stovetop with simple meal, controlled steam, few props
directions.buyerDetail: cooking surface, pan size, handle, and edge
directions.lesson: show the cooking surface in use while keeping the handle and rim visible

directions.setting: warm evening bedside or living room with one lit candle
directions.buyerDetail: jar shape, label area, wax level, and wick
directions.lesson: warm light can sell the use moment only if the jar and label remain readable

directions.setting: modern sofa with blanket naturally folded and draped in warm daylight
directions.buyerDetail: true color, weave, edge, and room scale
directions.lesson: show texture and size through a natural drape rather than a flat color block

directions.setting: green park path with a friendly dog standing naturally in soft daylight
directions.buyerDetail: straps, clip, adjustment points, and fit
directions.lesson: a real fit view answers more than a close product cutout

directions.setting: bright kitchen table with bottle beside cap and nipple parts
directions.buyerDetail: bottle size, included parts, nipple, cap, and grip
directions.lesson: lay out the included parts clearly and avoid unsupported safety claims

directions.setting: sunlit quiet studio floor with mat partly unrolled and one soft exercise cue
directions.buyerDetail: full length, surface texture, thickness edge, and roll-up size
directions.lesson: partial use shows grip surface and thickness while preserving overall size

directions.setting: bright airport lounge with suitcase upright on a clean floor
directions.buyerDetail: full size, wheels, handle, shell, and opening
directions.lesson: travel context is valuable when wheels, handle, and scale stay visible

directions.setting: modern living-room wall above simple furniture with natural side light
directions.buyerDetail: art color, border, paper edge, and wall scale
directions.lesson: the wall context answers size and color questions that a flat scan cannot

directions.setting: organized pantry counter with container open beside lid and dry food inside
directions.buyerDetail: empty shape, lid seal, stack height, and what fits
directions.lesson: show both the empty container and its everyday capacity

directions.setting: close elegant neckline or neutral jewelry display with soft clean light
directions.buyerDetail: pendant, chain, clasp, and believable worn scale
directions.lesson: wearing context makes scale clear while the clasp and chain remain inspectable
